author: Jan Wisseman Christie
title: Water and rice in early Java and Bali
mechanisms: Established rice farming in Malang uplands
Brantas/lower Solo water management and agricultural expansion from the tenth century
Maintained fields, land tenure and surplus production
exclusions: Rice double cropping is not documented before the fifteenth century; do not add a second starting harvest.
Regional evidence supplies no numerical cultivated hectares.
Direct coverage is strongest in Malang and the Brantas basin; other eastern locations use an explicit regional analogue.

inferred_game_assignment.basis: Shared maintained-field assessment, lower than core Bali/Trowulan because regional coverage is weaker; not a population-derived target.
